name: AccessControlDynamicFeeHook
mechanic: Whitelists who can provide liquidity and lets the owner set the swap fee.
plain: Only the owner and approved addresses may add liquidity, and the owner can override the LP fee applied to every swap. A permissioned pool with an operator-controlled fee.
rules: Only whitelisted addresses may add liquidity.
The owner sets the LP fee applied to all swaps.
